card.name: Just before words starting with "ri"
card.fires_on: The word or piece right before a word that begins with "ri", such as riociguat, ARIKAYCE, ripe or priory. It fires on the preceding word, not on the "ri" itself.

modes.label: Before riociguat
modes.description: A verb or linking word just before the drug name riociguat in label text.
modes.example: Exclude pregnancy prior to the start of treatment<< with>> riociguat.

modes.label: Inside ARIKAYCE
modes.description: The opening letter A of the brand name ARIKAYCE, where the next piece is RIKAYCE.
modes.example: Patients with neuromuscular disorders were not enrolled in<< A>>RIKAYCE clinical trials.

modes.label: Other ri- words
modes.description: A word or piece just before a general web word starting with ri, like ripe, priory or fimbriated.
modes.example: , bananas or avocados (particularly if<< over>>ripe), chocolate

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the next piece starting with "ri" and away from rip/ri forms, which fits a spelling-based prediction.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a word that starts with "ri", mostly the drug riociguat or the brand ARIKAYCE.
